title: Instance (2023)
headline: No defect was found in Theorem 3 or Lemma 8 within the stated scope. This is not a proof that they are correct.

claims.label: Theorem 3
claims.gist: Only the balanced seeding rule satisfies the three fairness axioms.
claims.statement: For knockout tournaments with 2^k players, balanced seeding is the unique seeding rule satisfying monotonicity, symmetry and the stronger-player axiom.

result.summary: No other rule satisfies the axioms for up to sixteen players; the proof read line by line.
result.search_scope: Every seeding rule for four, eight, sixteen and thirty-two players, checked against the three axioms. The proof read line by line.
result.limits: Thirty-two or more players are covered by the proof reading only.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.label: Lemma 8
claims.gist: Monotone rules never pair the two strongest players in round one.
claims.statement: Every monotone seeding rule keeps the two strongest players in different halves of the bracket.

result.summary: No counterexample for up to sixteen players.
result.search_scope: All monotone rules for four, eight and sixteen players.
result.limits: The search is finite; the general case rests on the proof.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).
